role: CI gate: forbids `Int64(x.timeIntervalSince(y) * 1000)` in Emuqu/Sources (except Date() receivers, MillisecondOffset.swift, or `date-ms-ok:` lines) in favour of MillisecondOffset.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; NO cd to repo root. Python scans pathlib('Emuqu/Sources') relative to the cwd; single-line regex only. Problems -> list + exit 1; else 'clean'. Wired: gates.yml (make date-ms-guard), ci.yml, Makefile.

flags.text: Run from any directory other than the repo root it scans zero files and prints 'clean' (verified by running from scripts/). Multi-line expressions and the watch target are not scanned.

The receiver group `[A-Za-z_][\w.?\[\]$]*` must start with a letter or underscore, so closure-argument forms `$0.timeIntervalSince(x) * 1000` never match. The banned truncating conversion is live at ReanalysisService+Sleep.swift:94-95, SleepBoundaryResolver.swift:294,295,312,313 (sleep start/end ms offsets) and OvernightChartsView+Stats.swift:637, and the gate prints clean.
